rationale: Once expanded, the numerator is dominated by −(revt−cogs)/at, so this is largely a repackaging of the Novy-Marx gross profitability anomaly with a leverage tilt, and the R&D term enters with the sign *opposite* to the well-documented R&D-intensity premium, meaning the "committed outlays" story and the mechanical driver of the signal are not the same thing.

The added leg, NEG(TS_SUM(sstk,5)/at), assigns *worse* expected returns to firms with low historical equity issuance, which directly contradicts the net-share-issuance anomaly and this same archive's repeated finding that heavy issuers underperform; additionally the nested SUMRANK imposes an arbitrary 1/2–1/4–1/4 weighting that makes any change versus the parent signal hard to attribute.

target_name: Stress Against Acquired Rather Than Organic Intangibles
rationale: A clean single-ingredient swap that genuinely discriminates collateral-illiquidity from research-continuity mechanisms, though it is an ablation of an existing archive winner whose stress composite is itself largely inverse gross profitability, and the proposal's own reasoning predicts a null.

target_name: Sustained Equity Retirement Against Hidden Knowledge Capital
rationale: This is a cosmetic smoothing of the archive's "Off-Balance-Sheet Knowledge Capital Meets Buybacks" (identical first leg, buyback leg merely 3-year averaged) and re-treads the already-tested persistence idea, so it is a rediscovery rather than a substantively different mechanism.

target_name: Hidden Brand and Research Capital Behind Buybacks
rationale: The R&D-plus-advertising intangible stock is the standard Peters–Taylor/brand-capital construction bolted onto an existing archive signal, and the stated benefit is unsupported — coverage is set by the buyback/asset legs and COALESCE(xad,0) leaves it unchanged while sparse advertising reporting means the term is zero for most firms.

target_name: Cutting the Lab to Service the Bank
rationale: The transition framing (rising leverage jointly with a contracting research program) is economically distinct from the archive's level-based stress states and the leg signs are internally consistent, though it partly overlaps the known debt-issuance and R&D-change anomalies and the un-coalesced xrd with a one-year lag will likely leave coverage near 5%.
